source_excerpts.text:
Scalar acquisition of a reusable nonreciprocal control-response map
Independent discovery packet, 2026-10-15

Disposition: conditional exact mathematical construction and synthetic checks.
Physical capability advantage, research priority, and mission achievement are
NOT ESTABLISHED. This operation was selected independently of the port-adjoint
framework. It changes the operator through actual controls and learns a reusable
scalar response map. It does not reconstruct an adjoint field.

1. Scientific opportunity and exact interface

The scientific task is to predict a fixed externally observed response under
many future combinations of local controls, through an otherwise unknown linear
network. This is relevant to programmable scattering, circuit response shaping,
and linearized transport. No benefit for an unknown nonlinear plant is claimed.

Assume the apparatus supplies, at a fixed frequency or in steady state,

    A(u) = A + P diag(u) P^T,
    f(u) = c^T A(u)^(-1) b,

where A is invertible, u has m components, and all queried operators are
invertible. The columns of P specify independently calibrated additive rank-one
actuator changes. b is the ordinary source and c specifies a detector. Physical
injection of c, internal field readout, reciprocity, known nonreciprocal support,
and physical reversal are unnecessary. Source and detector may coincide.

Indispensable supplied or separately acquired facts are linearity over the
operating range, fixed A,b,c during calibration and reuse, the additive rank-one
actuator laws and their independence, actual values of each applied u, stable
settling, and repeatable return to the reference configuration. The theorem
does not acquire or certify those premises from scalar responses.

Let

    H = P^T A^(-1) P,
    w = P^T A^(-1) b,
    v^T = c^T A^(-1) P,
    f0 = c^T A^(-1) b.

Woodbury gives, with D=diag(u),

    f(u) = f0 - v^T D (I + H D)^(-1) w.                 (1)

The formula also holds if some u_i vanish. For generic w_i != 0, put W=diag(w)
and use the diagonal gauge Hbar=W^(-1) H W and a_i=v_i w_i. Since W commutes
with every allowed D,

    f(u) = f0 - a^T D (I + Hbar D)^(-1) 1.              (2)

The estimator learns f0,a,Hbar from scalar queries. It does not learn the
original full A. Below, H denotes Hbar for economy.

Scalar control-map acquisition: costs, prior art, and claim boundary
2026-10-15

Result: an explicit generic exact acquisition schedule, plus decisive failures
of universal low-order qualification and of uniform robustness. No laboratory
demonstration, novelty finding, total-cost win, or mission achievement.

1. Strong primary comparators, read in this investigation

A. Sol, Prod'homme, Le Magoarou and del Hougne, Nature Communications 15, 2841
(2024), "Experimentally realized physical-model-based frugal wave control in
metasurface-programmable complex media."
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-024-46916-2

This is the strongest directly relevant physical baseline: acquiring a compact
reusable wave-response model from externally measured random configurations.
Their study includes prediction of one complex transmission coefficient and
larger accessible scattering matrices, then experimental wave control. The
reported 68-control cavity is reciprocal; it is not evidence for this new
nonreciprocal closed-form schedule. Their SISO calibration and task-focused
ambiguity tolerance already preempt a broad claim that scalar external data
can newly enable reusable control prediction. An equally informed comparator
must fit the same nonreciprocal rational model family to the same scalar data,
with multiple starts, noise treatment, calibration and independent joint
configurations. This comparator was not numerically executed here.

B. Del Hougne, "Virtual VNA 3.0: Unambiguous Scattering Matrix Estimation for
Non-Reciprocal Systems by Leveraging Tunable and Coupled Loads" (2025).
https://arxiv.org/html/2503.07239v1

This experimentally characterizes nonreciprocal networks using multiple
accessible VNA ports, three known individual terminations at each hidden port,
and known coupled loads. Its objective is an unambiguous full scattering
matrix. The quoted closed-form configuration count is 1+3m+m(m-1)/2 for more
than two accessible ports, with an extra setting in the two-port case.
Each setting returns a matrix, not one scalar. The present construction
predicts only a fixed scalar channel under future independent loads and
therefore permits diagonal-gauge and weighted-transpose ambiguity. It supplies
less information and uses a different physical interface. It has not beaten
Virtual VNA experimentally. The paper also explicitly distinguishes useful

source_excerpts.text:
Independent scientific-operation result, 2026-10-15

Status: secondary exact acquisition / negative robustness result.
No new demonstrated physical capability, novelty finding or total-cost win.

The construction acquires the entire fixed scalar response of an unknown
linear nonreciprocal plant under calibrated additive rank-one controls.
Its generic exact ternary schedule uses (3m^2-m+4)/2 scalar configurations.
Singletons identify diagonal responses; pairs give two directed choices;
anchored triples align the choices. The remaining weighted-transpose ambiguity
preserves every future allowed diagonal-control prediction. No objective-source
injection, internal fields or nonreciprocity-support premise is required.

Executed ternary m=32 test: 1522 configurations, eight seeds, 100 held-out
configurations per seed, noiseless median scalar prediction RMS error 3.27e-12.
Absolute scalar noise 1e-4 makes median error comparable to the entire
control-induced response. Intermediate nonreal roots are preserved/countable.

Two decisive limitations are proved:

1. A fixed-anchor schedule can agree exactly on all its queried data while an
   unqueried interior triple differs. Arbitrarily nearby generic plants have
   arbitrarily faint calibration separation. Genericity gives no uniform
   precision guarantee.

2. Two strictly dissipative plants can agree under EVERY intervention changing
   fewer than all m controls. Their future collective response difference
   tends to 1/sinh(2), with polynomial matrix conditioning. At m=32, actions
   m*1 versus 2m*1 are ranked oppositely. This rank reversal is not claimed for
   every small even m. One suitable full-support measurement distinguishes
   the pair; no exponential query lower bound is claimed.

Primary prior art already acquires reusable wave-control models from external
data, and Virtual VNA characterizes nonreciprocal networks through switched
loads. The 2026 read-once-determinant learner is a strong exact-algebraic
comparator. The present schedule may be a closed-form generic initialization
for the measured-model route. Physical priority and superiority are unproved.

Read CONSTRUCTION_AND_PROOF.txt for hypotheses/proof, and
COSTS_AND_COMPARATORS.txt for physical, scalar-readout, ternary/binary, precision,
control/reset, calibration and reuse boundaries. All numerical results are
synthetic. Scripts and JSON receipts
